title: cphmm: Close-Pair Hidden Markov Model for detecting recombination between closely related bacterial genomes
description: Python 3 implementation of the Close-Pair HMM (CP-HMM) for inferring homologous recombination between closely related bacterial genome pairs, as described in Liu & Good, "Dynamics of bacterial recombination in the human gut microbiome" (PLOS Biology 2024). Given the SNV differences along the genome between a pair of conspecific samples, the model segments the genome into clonally inherited and recombined regions. Includes the I/O layers for quasi-phased metagenome catalogs and cultured-isolate SNV tables, and the tract-extension add-on used in Liu & Good, "Dynamics of dN/dS within recombining bacterial populations".
